services.title: Female Infertility
services.shortDesc: Comprehensive evaluation and targeted medical treatment for ovulation disorders, PCOS, tubal factors, and hormonal balance.
services.fullDescription: Comprehensive diagnostic evaluation and individualized treatment plans for women addressing ovulation irregularities, polycystic ovarian syndrome (PCOS), endometriosis, tubal blockages, and hormonal imbalances with empathetic medical care.

subservices.title: Ovarian Reserve Profiling
subservices.desc: Precision AMH and antral follicle count diagnostics.
subservices.shortDesc: Precision AMH and antral follicle count diagnostics.
subservices.fullDescription: A comprehensive reproductive evaluation measuring the quantity and biological quality of a woman's remaining eggs through high-precision Anti-Müllerian Hormone (AMH) blood assays and high-resolution transvaginal ultrasound imaging.
procedureSteps: Complete reproductive history and menstrual pattern evaluation
High-precision serum Anti-Müllerian Hormone (AMH) and FSH/LH blood profiling
High-resolution transvaginal ultrasound to measure Antral Follicle Count (AFC)
Specialist consultation with Dr. P. Bharathi to interpret ovarian reserve status
benefits: Accurate forecasting of reproductive timeline and fertility potential
Customized medication dosages minimizing any ovarian hyperstimulation risk
Actionable insights for natural conception, IUI, IVF, or egg freezing
subservices.timeline: Same-day ultrasound & 24-hr lab report
subservices.suitableFor: Women planning pregnancy, individuals with irregular cycles, or those exploring fertility preservation.

subservices.title: Tubal Patency Testing
subservices.desc: Ultrasound and contrast imaging evaluating fallopian tube health.
subservices.shortDesc: Ultrasound and contrast imaging evaluating fallopian tube health.
subservices.fullDescription: Advanced diagnostic evaluation utilizing safe contrast-enhanced ultrasound (HyCoSy / HSG) to verify whether fallopian tubes are open, unobstructed, and capable of natural egg-sperm fertilization.
procedureSteps: Pre-procedure pelvic ultrasound and comfort preparation
Gentle introduction of biocompatible contrast solution into the uterus
Real-time ultrasound/fluoroscopic tracking of dye passage through both fallopian tubes
Immediate discussion of tubal findings and clear therapeutic options
benefits: Minimally invasive, outpatient diagnostic procedure with quick recovery
Direct visualization of uterine cavity shape and bilateral tubal patency
Essential first-line assessment before recommending IUI or natural conception
subservices.timeline: 30-minute outpatient procedure (performed post-menstruation)
subservices.suitableFor: Couples with unexplained infertility, suspected pelvic infections, or prior pelvic surgeries.

subservices.title: PCOS & Endometriosis Care
subservices.desc: Targeted hormonal regulation and lifestyle management.
subservices.shortDesc: Targeted hormonal regulation and lifestyle management.
subservices.fullDescription: Multidisciplinary medical management for Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) and Endometriosis, combining endocrine balance, metabolic support, pain management, and tailored follicular stimulation.
procedureSteps: Detailed metabolic, insulin resistance, and hormonal panel analysis
Pelvic mapping ultrasound to identify ovarian morphology and endometriotic lesions
Integrated medical therapy, cycle regulation, and personalized lifestyle protocol
Targeted ovulation assistance timed with natural intercourse or assisted reproduction
benefits: Restores regular ovulatory cycles and optimizes egg maturation quality
Reduces pelvic discomfort, chronic inflammation, and metabolic distress
Significantly boosts natural and assisted conception success rates
subservices.timeline: Ongoing cycle tracking with 3-6 month milestone evaluations
subservices.suitableFor: Women experiencing irregular cycles, acne/hirsutism, painful periods, or chronic pelvic pain.

subservices.title: Ovulation Induction
subservices.desc: Personalized follicular stimulation and cycle tracking.
subservices.shortDesc: Personalized follicular stimulation and cycle tracking.
subservices.fullDescription: Controlled medical stimulation using oral medications or low-dose gonadotropins designed to encourage the development and timed release of one or two mature, healthy eggs in anovulatory or irregular cycles.
procedureSteps: Baseline ultrasound on Day 2/3 of menstrual cycle to confirm resting ovaries
Targeted prescription of oral medications (Letrozole/Clomiphene) or gonadotropins
Serial serial follicular ultrasound scans to monitor egg growth and endometrial lining
Administration of trigger injection followed by precisely timed intercourse or IUI
benefits: First-line, non-invasive, and cost-effective fertility treatment
Eliminates guesswork with real-time ultrasound cycle tracking
High success rate for women with anovulatory infertility and PCOS
subservices.timeline: Single 14-day cycle monitoring pathway
subservices.suitableFor: Women with irregular or absent ovulation, PCOS, or mild ovulatory dysfunction.

faqs.question: What causes female infertility?
faqs.answer: Common factors include ovulation disorders, PCOS, blocked fallopian tubes, uterine fibroids, and age-related ovarian reserve decline.

faqs.question: How is female fertility evaluated?
faqs.answer: We conduct pelvic ultrasounds, hormonal blood profiles (AMH, FSH, LH), and tubal patency assessments.

services.title: Male Infertility
services.shortDesc: Advanced semen analysis, sperm function diagnostics, and specialized therapeutic solutions for male-factor reproductive health.
services.fullDescription: Specialized evaluation and therapeutic interventions for male-factor reproductive health combining computerized semen analysis, sperm function assessments, and advanced micromanipulation technologies.

subservices.title: Computerized Semen Analysis
subservices.desc: Standardized count, motility, and morphological evaluations.
subservices.shortDesc: Standardized count, motility, and morphological evaluations.
subservices.fullDescription: Automated and microscopic evaluation of semen parameters strictly compliant with the latest WHO clinical guidelines, assessing total sperm count, progressive motility, vitality, pH, and Kruger strict morphology.
procedureSteps: 2 to 5 days abstinence guidelines and private collection facility
Liquefaction and standardized physical parameter testing (volume, viscosity, pH)
Automated computerized tracking of sperm concentration and progressive motility
High-magnification stained strict morphological scoring and detailed diagnostic report
benefits: Provides an accurate baseline of male reproductive health and fertilization capacity
Identifies specific sub-factors (oligozoospermia, asthenozoospermia, teratozoospermia)
Guides the exact selection of optimal ART treatment (IUI vs IVF vs ICSI)
subservices.timeline: Same-day analysis & comprehensive report within 4 hours
subservices.suitableFor: All men undergoing preliminary fertility evaluation or follow-up post-treatment.

subservices.title: DNA Fragmentation Index (DFI)
subservices.desc: Assessing sperm genetic integrity for embryo viability.
subservices.shortDesc: Assessing sperm genetic integrity for embryo viability.
subservices.fullDescription: Advanced molecular diagnostic test evaluating breaks and integrity in sperm DNA strands. Elevated DNA fragmentation is strongly linked to fertilization failure, poor blastocyst formation, and recurrent early pregnancy loss.
procedureSteps: Specialized sperm chromatin dispersion or TUNEL laboratory assay
Measurement of intact versus fragmented DNA in sperm heads
Calculation of DFI percentage (normal < 15%, moderate 15-25%, elevated > 25%)
Clinical prescription of antioxidant therapy, lifestyle modifications, or PICSI
benefits: Identifies hidden genetic causes of unexplained infertility that standard tests miss
Helps explain recurrent IVF cycle failures or early miscarriages
Directs the clinical team to utilize PICSI or magnetic sperm selection (MACS)
subservices.timeline: Laboratory turnaround within 48 hours
subservices.suitableFor: Couples with recurrent pregnancy loss, prior failed IVF/ICSI cycles, or elevated paternal age.

subservices.title: Sperm Washing & Isolation
subservices.desc: Density gradient centrifugation for optimal motile sperm yield.
subservices.shortDesc: Density gradient centrifugation for optimal motile sperm yield.
subservices.fullDescription: Specialized laboratory processing separating healthy, progressive motile sperm from seminal fluid, debris, non-motile cells, and prostaglandins, preparing an optimal concentrated sample for IUI or IVF.
procedureSteps: Semen sample liquefaction under temperature-controlled laminar airflow
Multi-layer density gradient centrifugation to separate motile sperm
Swim-up culture extraction in nutrient-rich physiological media
Final count and motility verification prior to intrauterine insemination or IVF dish
benefits: Eliminates prostaglandins and bacteria to prevent uterine cramping and infection
Yields the highest concentration of functionally active, forward-swimming sperm
Significantly boosts fertilization potential in both natural and assisted cycles
subservices.timeline: 45-60 minutes specialized laboratory procedure on day of treatment
subservices.suitableFor: All IUI cycles, IVF fertilizations, and cryopreservation preparations.

subservices.title: Surgical Sperm Retrieval (TESA/PESA)
subservices.desc: Minimally invasive extraction for obstructive azoospermia.
subservices.shortDesc: Minimally invasive extraction for obstructive azoospermia.
subservices.fullDescription: Minimally invasive micro-surgical procedures (Percutaneous Epididymal Sperm Aspiration - PESA, and Testicular Sperm Aspiration - TESA) performed under local anesthesia to retrieve viable sperm directly from the epididymis or testes.
procedureSteps: Pre-procedure urological assessment, hormonal profiling, and gentle local anesthesia
Fine-needle aspiration (PESA) from epididymis or tiny testicular biopsy (TESA)
Immediate real-time embryological microscope verification of retrieved motile sperm
Direct utilization for ICSI fertilization or ultra-rapid cryopreservation
benefits: Offers biological fatherhood for men with zero sperm in ejaculate (azoospermia)
Virtually painless, daycare outpatient procedure with same-day return home
Pairs seamlessly with ICSI to achieve high fertilization and pregnancy rates
subservices.timeline: 20-minute daycare procedure under local anesthesia
subservices.suitableFor: Men with obstructive azoospermia (e.g., prior vasectomy, congenital absence of vas deferens) or non-obstructive azoospermia.

faqs.question: How common is male infertility?
faqs.answer: Male factor infertility contributes to roughly 40-50% of all infertility cases, making early dual-partner evaluation essential.

faqs.question: Can low sperm motility be treated?
faqs.answer: Yes. Depending on the root cause, lifestyle improvements, medical therapy, and assisted reproductive procedures like ICSI provide high success rates.

services.title: IVF (In Vitro Fertilization)
services.shortDesc: State-of-the-art ART protocol facilitating controlled egg retrieval, precision fertilization in our embryology lab, and gentle embryo transfer.
services.fullDescription: In Vitro Fertilization (IVF) is our flagship assisted reproductive technology. Conducted in state-of-the-art embryology suites, IVF facilitates controlled ovarian stimulation, gentle egg retrieval, precision fertilization, and optimal embryo transfer.

subservices.title: Controlled Ovarian Stimulation
subservices.desc: Personalized hormone regimens tailored to your reserve.
subservices.shortDesc: Personalized hormone regimens tailored to your reserve.
subservices.fullDescription: Customized medication protocol using gonadotropin injections over 10-12 days to stimulate both ovaries to safely recruit multiple mature eggs, closely monitored via serial ultrasounds and hormone tests.
procedureSteps: Baseline ultrasound and hormonal assessment on Day 2 of menstrual cycle
Administration of tailored subcutaneous gonadotropins (FSH/HMG)
Serial follicular growth ultrasounds and estradiol level monitoring every 2-3 days
Precise administration of trigger injection (hCG or GnRH agonist) 36 hours before egg retrieval
benefits: Maximizes the number of mature, healthy eggs retrieved in a single cycle
Carefully calibrated dosages preventing Ovarian Hyperstimulation Syndrome (OHSS)
Direct oversight by Dr. P. Bharathi for optimal timing and patient comfort
subservices.timeline: 10 to 14 days of stimulation and monitoring
subservices.suitableFor: All patients entering an IVF or ICSI cycle.

subservices.title: Outpatient Egg Retrieval
subservices.desc: Gentle, ultrasound-guided ovum pick-up under mild sedation.
subservices.shortDesc: Gentle, ultrasound-guided ovum pick-up under mild sedation.
subservices.fullDescription: A quick, comfortable minor procedure performed under short intravenous sedation where mature eggs are gently aspirated from ovarian follicles using a fine ultrasound-guided needle.
procedureSteps: Pre-procedure check-in and gentle intravenous sedation by expert anesthetist
High-resolution transvaginal ultrasound needle aspiration of each follicular fluid sac
Immediate transfer of follicular fluid to the embryology clean-room under heated stages
Embryologist counts and verifies total mature (MII) oocytes retrieved
benefits: Completely painless, quick 15-20 minute daycare procedure with no surgical incisions
Short recovery period allowing patients to return home comfortably after 2 hours
Direct clean-room handoff ensuring zero temperature or atmospheric shock to oocytes
subservices.timeline: 15-20 minutes procedure, total clinic stay approx. 2-3 hours
subservices.suitableFor: Women undergoing IVF, ICSI, or elective egg freezing.

subservices.title: Clean-Room Lab Fertilization
subservices.desc: HEPA-filtered incubation simulating physiological warmth.
subservices.shortDesc: HEPA-filtered incubation simulating physiological warmth.
subservices.fullDescription: High-precision fertilization and embryo culture in state-of-the-art class 10,000 embryology clean rooms with tri-gas incubators mimicking natural human fallopian and uterine conditions.
procedureSteps: Sperm preparation and density gradient separation
Standard IVF co-incubation or ICSI micro-injection of mature oocytes
Incubation in tri-gas, VOC-filtered incubators providing stable pH and temperature
Fertilization check at 16-18 hours to confirm normal 2PN diploid zygote formation
benefits: ISO-certified clean air filtration eliminates volatile organic compounds (VOCs)
Simulates physiological maternal environment for optimal embryo cellular division
High fertilization rates and superior blastocyst development
subservices.timeline: Day 0 fertilization check through Day 5/6 extended embryo culture
subservices.suitableFor: All IVF and ICSI treatment cycles.

subservices.title: Ultrasound Embryo Transfer
subservices.desc: Precision placement of viable embryos into the uterine cavity.
subservices.shortDesc: Precision placement of viable embryos into the uterine cavity.
subservices.fullDescription: The final, deeply rewarding milestone of the IVF cycle where one or two selected high-grade embryos are gently placed into the optimal implantation zone of the uterus under real-time abdominal ultrasound guidance.
procedureSteps: Endometrial preparation and ultrasound confirmation of optimal trilaminar thickness
Embryo selection and loading into a soft, atraumatic catheter by senior embryologist
Real-time ultrasound guidance to place the embryo precisely 1-2 cm from the uterine fundus
Microscopic catheter check confirming complete transfer, followed by gentle rest
benefits: Completely painless, gentle 10-minute procedure requiring no anesthesia
Real-time visual confirmation allowing parents to see the embryo placement flash
Promotes optimal implantation and maximizes single healthy pregnancy rates
subservices.timeline: 15-minute procedure followed by 30 minutes rest in recovery suite
subservices.suitableFor: Fresh or Frozen Embryo Transfer (FET) cycles.

faqs.question: What is the standard IVF treatment cycle timeline?
faqs.answer: A complete IVF cycle typically spans 3 to 4 weeks from initial stimulation to embryo transfer.

faqs.question: Is IVF painful?
faqs.answer: Egg retrieval is conducted under light sedation, ensuring a comfortable, pain-free experience.

services.title: IUI (Intrauterine Insemination)
services.shortDesc: A gentle, minimally invasive treatment placing concentrated, highly mobile sperm directly into the uterus at the time of ovulation.
services.fullDescription: Intrauterine Insemination (IUI) is a gentle, cost-effective first-line fertility treatment. Highly concentrated and washed motile sperm are placed directly into the uterus at the exact time of ovulation.

subservices.title: Follicular Monitoring
subservices.desc: Real-time ultrasound tracking of dominant follicle growth.
subservices.shortDesc: Real-time ultrasound tracking of dominant follicle growth.
subservices.fullDescription: Sequential transvaginal ultrasound evaluations to track follicle development, endometrial thickness, and natural ovulation signs to precisely time the insemination procedure.
procedureSteps: Baseline scan on Day 2/3 to assess resting ovaries and endometrium
Serial ultrasound scans from Day 9/10 to track dominant follicle reaching 18-20 mm
Measurement of endometrial triple-line pattern
Administration of trigger injection when dominant follicle reaches optimal maturity
benefits: Pinpoints the exact fertile window for maximum conception probability
Eliminates guesswork in irregular cycles
Non-invasive and quick in-clinic checkups
subservices.timeline: 3 to 4 quick ultrasound visits over 8-10 days
subservices.suitableFor: Couples undergoing IUI or natural timed intercourse cycles.

subservices.title: Sperm Processing & Wash
subservices.desc: Concentration of highest-motility sperm for insemination.
subservices.shortDesc: Concentration of highest-motility sperm for insemination.
subservices.fullDescription: Laboratory density-gradient separation isolating the most active, normal-morphology sperm into a concentrated physiological suspension, removing prostaglandins and debris.
procedureSteps: Sample collection in private sterile suite
Density gradient centrifugation separation
Sperm pellet washing and suspension in sterile nutrient media
Post-wash count and motility verification
benefits: Concentrates millions of forward-progressive sperm into a small volume
Removes components that cause uterine contractions or infection
Increases fertilization chances significantly
subservices.timeline: 60 minutes laboratory preparation on the morning of IUI
subservices.suitableFor: All partner or donor IUI procedures.

subservices.title: Synchronized Insemination
subservices.desc: Painless in-clinic placement timed with ovulation trigger.
subservices.shortDesc: Painless in-clinic placement timed with ovulation trigger.
subservices.fullDescription: A quick, painless in-clinic procedure where washed sperm is gently introduced into the upper uterine cavity via a fine, flexible catheter 36-40 hours after trigger injection.
procedureSteps: Patient positioned comfortably on examination couch (no anesthesia needed)
Insertion of soft sterile catheter through the cervical canal
Slow, gentle injection of the concentrated sperm suspension
Brief 15-minute resting period before resuming normal daily activities
benefits: Painless procedure taking less than 10 minutes with zero downtime
Bypasses cervical mucus hostility or anatomical barriers
Positions sperm in close physical proximity to released egg
subservices.timeline: 10-minute in-clinic procedure
subservices.suitableFor: Couples with unexplained infertility, mild male factors, or cervical hostility.

subservices.title: Luteal Phase Support
subservices.desc: Progesterone support promoting healthy implantation.
subservices.shortDesc: Progesterone support promoting healthy implantation.
subservices.fullDescription: Post-insemination medication regimen supporting the uterine endometrium with progesterone to optimize conditions for embryo attachment and early pregnancy maintenance.
procedureSteps: Prescription of natural micronized progesterone support (oral or vaginal)
Guidance on activity, hydration, and healthy lifestyle during the two-week wait
Scheduled serum beta-hCG pregnancy blood test at 14 days post-IUI
Immediate doctor consultation to interpret test results and guide next steps
benefits: Strengthens the endometrial lining for firm embryo implantation
Supports natural progesterone production in stimulated cycles
Provides clear clinical guidance and reassurance throughout the two-week wait
subservices.timeline: 14-day medication support culminating in pregnancy test
subservices.suitableFor: All women completing an IUI or ovulatory stimulation cycle.

faqs.question: Who is a good candidate for IUI?
faqs.answer: Couples with unexplained infertility, mild male factor concerns, or cervical factor issues and patent fallopian tubes.

faqs.question: How long does the IUI procedure take?
faqs.answer: The insemination itself takes only 5 to 10 minutes and requires minimal resting time afterward.

services.title: ICSI (Intracytoplasmic Sperm Injection)
services.shortDesc: Advanced micromanipulation technique where a single high-quality sperm is injected directly into a mature egg to maximize fertilization.
services.fullDescription: Intracytoplasmic Sperm Injection (ICSI) is an advanced micromanipulation technique used alongside IVF. A single selected healthy sperm is injected directly into the cytoplasm of a mature egg, overcoming severe fertilization challenges.

subservices.title: High-Power Micromanipulation
subservices.desc: Precision inverted microscope control for injection.
subservices.shortDesc: Precision inverted microscope control for injection.
subservices.fullDescription: Use of high-magnification motorized inverted microscopes equipped with electronic micro-injectors to manipulate individual gametes with sub-micron precision.
procedureSteps: Preparation of heated microscope stage and micro-tools
Placement of mature oocytes in micro-droplets of buffered media
Stabilization of egg using a microscopic holding pipette
Sub-micron alignment for direct injection
benefits: Enables precise handling of microscopic cellular structures without trauma
Bypasses physical sperm-egg binding and penetration barriers
Conducted by specialized senior embryologists
subservices.timeline: Performed 4-6 hours post-egg retrieval
subservices.suitableFor: Severe male factor cases, low oocyte count, or prior IVF fertilization failure.

subservices.title: Single Sperm Selection
subservices.desc: Morphological isolation of the single best sperm.
subservices.shortDesc: Morphological isolation of the single best sperm.
subservices.fullDescription: High-magnification morphological scrutiny selecting the single healthiest, progressive, intact sperm for micro-injection, ensuring optimal genetic contribution.
procedureSteps: Sperm sample placement in viscous polyvinylpyrrolidone (PVP) media to slow movement
Individual morphological evaluation of head symmetry, acrosome, and tail integrity
Micro-immobilization of the chosen single sperm by touching the tail tip
Aspiration into the micro-injection pipette
benefits: Selects only top-grade, structurally sound spermatozoa
Improves fertilization rates and embryo cleavage quality
Minimizes transmission of defective sperm morphology
subservices.timeline: Integral part of the ICSI procedure
subservices.suitableFor: Cases with low sperm count (oligozoospermia) or abnormal morphology (teratozoospermia).

subservices.title: Direct Oocyte Micro-Injection
subservices.desc: Bypassing outer egg barriers for guaranteed entry.
subservices.shortDesc: Bypassing outer egg barriers for guaranteed entry.
subservices.fullDescription: Direct introduction of the single immobilized sperm through the zona pellucida and oolemma directly into the egg cytoplasm using an ultra-fine glass micro-needle.
procedureSteps: Egg holding with polar body oriented at 6 or 12 o'clock
Smooth penetration of zona pellucida with micro-injection needle
Gentle aspiration of cytoplasm to confirm membrane rupture (oolemma break)
Smooth injection of sperm and careful withdrawal of pipette
benefits: Guarantees sperm entry into the egg cytoplasm regardless of outer shell thickness
Overcomes severe sperm motility or binding deficiencies
Yields standard fertilization rates of 75-85%
subservices.timeline: Approx. 1-2 minutes per mature egg
subservices.suitableFor: Couples requiring assisted fertilization.

subservices.title: Fertilization Assessment
subservices.desc: Confirming normal two-pronuclei (2PN) fertilization.
subservices.shortDesc: Confirming normal two-pronuclei (2PN) fertilization.
subservices.fullDescription: Microscopic inspection 16-18 hours post-injection to verify normal diploid fertilization evidenced by the clear appearance of two pronuclei and two polar bodies.
procedureSteps: Gentle examination of injected oocytes under heated inverted microscope
Confirmation of two distinct pronuclei (one maternal, one paternal)
Transfer of fertilized zygotes into specialized extended cleavage media
Detailed parent fertilization update provided by clinical coordinator
benefits: Confirms successful genetic combination and normal fertilization
Filters out abnormal multi-pronucleate or unfertilized eggs
Provides immediate clarity to the clinical team and prospective parents
subservices.timeline: Next morning (Day 1 post-retrieval)
subservices.suitableFor: All ICSI and IVF treatment cycles.

faqs.question: How is ICSI different from standard IVF?
faqs.answer: In standard IVF, eggs and sperm mix in a dish for natural fertilization. In ICSI, a single selected sperm is directly injected into each mature egg.

services.title: PICSI (Physiological ICSI)
services.shortDesc: Enhanced physiological sperm selection utilizing hyaluronan binding to identify mature sperm with optimal DNA integrity.
services.fullDescription: Physiological ICSI (PICSI) utilizes hyaluronan binding to select mature, functionally competent sperm with lower DNA fragmentation, optimizing embryo quality and pregnancy safety.

subservices.title: Hyaluronan Hydrogel Binding
subservices.desc: Simulating natural zona pellucida receptor binding.
subservices.shortDesc: Simulating natural zona pellucida receptor binding.
subservices.fullDescription: Utilization of specialized culture dishes micro-coated with hyaluronan hydrogel (a natural component of the egg's cumulus complex) to bind only biochemically mature sperm expressing intact receptors.
procedureSteps: Preparation of specialized PICSI dishes with hyaluronan microdots
Droplet placement of washed motile sperm onto the hydrogel matrix
Real-time observation of sperm binding via their head receptors while tails continue beating
Aspiration of bound sperm for micro-injection
benefits: Mimics the natural biological selection mechanism occurring in female fallopian tubes
Separates biochemically mature sperm from immature spermatozoa
Significantly reduces chromosomal aneuploidy risk in resulting embryos
subservices.timeline: Conducted concurrently with micro-injection on Day 0
subservices.suitableFor: Couples with elevated sperm DNA fragmentation or unexplained recurrent IVF failure.

subservices.title: Intact DNA Screening
subservices.desc: Selecting sperm with lower chromosomal aneuploidy.
subservices.shortDesc: Selecting sperm with lower chromosomal aneuploidy.
subservices.fullDescription: Hyaluronan-bound sperm demonstrate significantly lower rates of DNA strand breakage, normal nuclear chromatin packaging, and reduced frequency of chromosomal aneuploidies.
procedureSteps: Identification of bound sperm demonstrating normal head morphology
Micro-pipette extraction of bound sperm showing optimal motility dynamics
Transfer to injection droplet for ICSI procedure
Documentation of physiological selection parameters in laboratory log
benefits: Protects embryo genetic integrity by filtering out damaged paternal DNA
Reduces early embryonic developmental arrest and pregnancy loss
Improves blastocyst conversion rates
subservices.timeline: Integrated into PICSI dish workflow
subservices.suitableFor: Couples with previous poor blastocyst development or elevated paternal age.

subservices.title: Targeted Micro-Injection
subservices.desc: Injecting physiologically mature selected sperm.
subservices.shortDesc: Injecting physiologically mature selected sperm.
subservices.fullDescription: Direct micro-injection of the hyaluronan-selected mature sperm into mature oocytes, marrying physiological selection with precision micromanipulation.
procedureSteps: Immobilization of hyaluronan-bound sperm
Direct intra-cytoplasmic injection into mature MII oocyte
Incubation in high-purity tri-gas culture suites
Observation of subsequent zygotic cleavage milestones
benefits: Maximizes fertilization potential using biochemically proven competent sperm
Higher clinical pregnancy rates compared to conventional ICSI in indicated cohorts
Enhances peace of mind for couples with prior failed cycles
subservices.timeline: Completed on Day 0 of egg retrieval
subservices.suitableFor: Patients with prior ICSI failure or elevated DFI > 20%.

subservices.title: Recurrent Loss Protocol
subservices.desc: Recommended for unexplained prior cycle failures.
subservices.shortDesc: Recommended for unexplained prior cycle failures.
subservices.fullDescription: Comprehensive clinical protocol integrating PICSI with extended blastocyst culture and luteal support specifically tailored for couples coping with recurrent pregnancy loss (RPL).
procedureSteps: Complete paternal and maternal diagnostic audit and genetic carrier screening
Application of PICSI sperm selection to eliminate paternal DNA fragmentation impact
Extended culture to Day 5 blastocyst stage with laser-assisted hatching if indicated
Personalized endometrial receptivity synchronization and immune-modulatory support
benefits: Significantly reduces miscarriage rates in recurrent loss couples
Holistic dual-partner diagnostic and therapeutic optimization
Guided directly by Dr. P. Bharathi's extensive clinical expertise
subservices.timeline: Full cycle protocol spanning preparation to 12-week pregnancy milestone
subservices.suitableFor: Couples who have experienced 2 or more unexplained miscarriages or IVF failures.

benefits.title: Physiological Selection

subservices.desc: Safe removal of 4-6 placental cells without inner cell damage.
subservices.shortDesc: Safe removal of 4-6 placental cells without inner cell damage.

Targeted laser separation of outer trophectoderm cell junctions
Gentle aspiration into biopsy micro-pipette and sterile transfer to sequencing tubes

Negligible impact on embryo thawing survival and implantation potential

services.title: Blastocyst Culture
services.shortDesc: Extended embryo culture to Day 5/6, allowing the natural selection of the strongest, most viable embryos for higher implantation rates.
services.fullDescription: Extended embryo culture up to Day 5/6 allowing natural development into the blastocyst stage. This enables precise morphological selection of the most viable embryos for single embryo transfer.

subservices.title: Day-5 Extended Incubation
subservices.desc: Simulating the natural uterine timing of embryo development.
subservices.shortDesc: Simulating the natural uterine timing of embryo development.
subservices.fullDescription: Culture of fertilized embryos in sequential nutrient media up to Day 5/6 (blastocyst stage consisting of 100-150 cells), allowing embryos to self-select and reach natural physiological uterine synchronization.
procedureSteps: Day 3 cleavage embryo assessment and transfer into blastocyst growth media
Incubation in uninterrupted benchtop incubators with low oxygen (5% O2) tension
Observation of compaction, cavitation, and blastocoel expansion on Day 5 and Day 6
Selection of fully expanded, high-viability blastocysts
benefits: Filters out embryos with early developmental arrest (natural physiological selection)
Aligns embryo development with the receptive window of the uterine endometrium
Significantly higher implantation rate per transferred embryo
subservices.timeline: Extended culture from Day 3 to Day 5/6 post-fertilization
subservices.suitableFor: Couples undergoing IVF/ICSI, particularly those with good embryo numbers on Day 3.

subservices.title: Gardner Grading Assessment
subservices.desc: High-precision inner cell mass & trophectoderm scoring.
subservices.shortDesc: High-precision inner cell mass & trophectoderm scoring.
subservices.fullDescription: Standardized international Gardner morphological grading evaluating three critical blastocyst parameters: expansion grade (1-6), Inner Cell Mass quality (A, B, C), and Trophectoderm cell quality (A, B, C).
procedureSteps: High-magnification microscopic examination on morning of Day 5 and Day 6
Assessment of blastocoel cavity expansion and zona thinning (1 to 6)
Evaluation of Inner Cell Mass (ICM) compaction and cell count (Grade A, B, C)
Evaluation of Trophectoderm (TE) cellular cohesion and layer continuity (Grade A, B, C)
benefits: Provides an objective, clinical metric for selecting the single best embryo
Detailed grading report shared with parents for complete transparency
Correlates directly with clinical pregnancy and live birth rates
subservices.timeline: Conducted on Day 5 and Day 6 mornings
subservices.suitableFor: All blastocyst culture and vitrification cycles.

Atraumatic ultrasound-guided uterine placement into the implantation zone
Immediate post-transfer care and personalized luteal phase support
Pregnancy confirmation via serum beta-hCG at Day 12 post-transfer
benefits: High live birth rate comparable to multi-embryo transfer
Eliminates high-risk complications of multiple pregnancies (premature birth, low birth weight)
Safest standard of care recommended by global fertility guidelines
subservices.timeline: Single transfer procedure day
subservices.suitableFor: All patients with high-quality blastocysts available.

faqs.question: Why is blastocyst transfer preferred?
faqs.answer: Blastocyst embryos have demonstrated developmental competence and align naturally with the uterine window of implantation.

faqs.question: When should I visit a fertility center?
faqs.answer: Individuals or couples who have been trying to conceive for over a year (or six months if the female partner is over 35), or those with irregular cycles, previous surgeries, or known reproductive conditions, should visit a fertility specialist for timely evaluation.

faqs.question: What services are offered at Janvithas Fertility Center?
faqs.answer: We offer complete reproductive healthcare including Female & Male Infertility Evaluations, IUI, IVF, ICSI, PICSI, Genetic Programs, Fertility Preservation (egg/sperm freezing), and Blastocyst Culture.

faqs.question: Do both partners need to get evaluated?
faqs.answer: Yes. Conception involves both partners equally. A comprehensive dual evaluation of both partners ensures accurate diagnosis and the most effective, personalized treatment pathway.

faqs.question: Is fertility treatment affordable at Janvithas Fertility Center?
faqs.answer: We believe in affordable specialty healthcare for all. Our center provides transparent guidance, ethical clinical protocols, and accessible treatment options without hidden charges.
